title: Flip the Switch Hackathon
description: Take an AI agent you already use, from Claude Code and Codex to LangChain and Google ADK, connect it to Slack, Teams, Discord and Telegram with Switch, and build a workflow where it gets real work done with your teammates.

custom_questions.label: Did you star [Switch GitHub Repository](https://devtoolsacademy.link/wemakedevs) yet?
custom_questions.description: One random person who stars the repository will win a Keychron Keyboard! [https://github.com/sandbox-quantum/switch](https://devtoolsacademy.link/wemakedevs)
options: Yes, I want to participate in the Keychron Keyboard giveaway!
No, I don't want an amazing keyboard

submission_questions.label: Tracks you are submitting for
submission_questions.description: You can participate in more than one track. Everyone with a submission is considered for the 'Code with Wispr' Track, as long as they upload their Wispr Usage Card in **Track Details** section.

submission_questions.label: Project description
submission_questions.description: What problem does your project solve, and who is it for?

submission_questions.label: GitHub Repository or contribution
submission_questions.description:
- Track 1 & 2: Make sure it's public repository, with a README that explains how to set it up.
- Track 3: Please put in your main pull request

submission_questions.label: Demo video
submission_questions.description:
Keep it under 3 minutes. Host it on YouTube or Loom, and make sure it's public or unlisted.

- Track 1 & 2: Show the agent working in a real chat with your teammates. 
- Track 3: Please walk us through your most important contribution

submission_questions.label: Live demo or deployment
submission_questions.description: Leave blank if your project doesn't have a live demo.

submission_questions.label: Blog post
submission_questions.description: Share your post about building with Switch, and the best blog wins AirPods 5.

submission_questions.label: Your Wispr usage card
submission_questions.description: **Required for Code with Wispr**. In the Wispr Flow desktop app, open *Insights*, then *Your usage*, then *Share*, and upload the card.

submission_questions.label: Your #HowISwitch post
submission_questions.description: The top 5 posts win a Logitech mechanical keyboard.

submission_questions.label: How did you use Switch in your project?
submission_questions.description:
- Which agent did you connect (Claude Code, Codex, LangChain, Google ADK or something else)?
- Which platforms does it run on (Slack, Teams, Discord, Telegram)?
- What real work does it do, and how do your teammates work with it?

submission_questions.label: What did you like about Switch, and what would you improve?
submission_questions.description: What worked, what got in the way, and what you'd want Switch to do next.
